verdict.rationale: Decagon is a SaaS AI customer-support platform, so a documented public API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents a public API that users can call to drive the product. The JWT tokens it mentions let Decagon's agents reach customer systems, and the MCP and Browser Actions items are about tools the agent itself uses. The docs stress 'no custom code required', and every OpenAPI/Swagger path probed returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
